parole.significato: Of, pertaining to, or from the region of Surmeir in Switzerland
parole.testo: Borrowed from Romansh surmiran, from the region Surmeir in Albula Valley. The placename is interpreted to mean "above the wall," from sur (“above”) (a derivative of Latin supra (“above”)) + meir (“wall”) (from Latin murus). There is no corresponding Swiss German name, which instead uses Mittelbünden

parole.significato: Of or relating to a group of dialects of the Romansh language spoken in the Surselva, on the western bank of the Rhine.
parole.testo: From Romansh sursilvan, named after the Surselva region in Switzerland.
